description: Enhanced boundary coverage for control-character neutralization. Covers: a string with no control characters (pure passthrough); the empty string (yields an empty sanitized value); a run of multiple consecutive CRLF pairs each mapped one-for-one to underscores; a string ending in a single line-feed (no trailing-character special-casing); and confirmation that other whitespace such as a horizontal tab is NOT neutralized and passes through unchanged.
